The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Email Event ASIM filtering parser for Proofpoint POD MailLog
properties.query:
let parser = (
  starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
  endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
  ipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  emailfromaddress_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  emailrecipient_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  emailsubject_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  emaildirection_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  emaildeliverylocation_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventresult:string='*',
  disabled:bool=false,
  pack:bool=false)
{
  ProofpointPODMailLog_CL
  | where not(disabled)
  | where (isnull(starttime) or eventTime >= starttime or (isnull(eventTime) and TimeGenerated >= starttime))
      and (isnull(endtime) or eventTime <= endtime or (isnull(eventTime) and TimeGenerated <= endtime))
  | where array_length(emailfromaddress_has_any) == 0 and array_length(emailrecipient_has_any) == 0
      and array_length(emailsubject_has_any) == 0 and array_length(emaildeliverylocation_in) == 0
  | where array_length(emaildirection_in) == 0 or "Unknown" in (emaildirection_in)
  | where isnotempty(tostring(sm.qid)) and (bag_has_key(sm, "from") or array_length(sm["to"]) > 0)
  | extend
      IsDelivery = coalesce(array_length(sm["to"]), 0) > 0,
      Dsn = tostring(sm.dsn)
  | extend EventResult = case(Dsn startswith "2.", "Success", Dsn startswith "4." or Dsn startswith "5.", "Failure", "NA")
  | where eventresult == "*" or EventResult == eventresult
  | extend
      Relay = tostring(sm.relay),
      Dvc = coalesce(tostring(pps.agent), tostring(metadata.origin.data.agent)),
      EventStartTime = coalesce(eventTime, TimeGenerated),
      EmailMailFromAddress = trim(@"[<>\s]", tostring(sm["from"])),
      EmailSizeBytes = tolong(sm.sizeBytes),
      DeliveryStatus = tostring(sm.stat)
  | parse Relay with RelayHost " [" RelayIp "]" *
  | extend RelayIp = iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(RelayIp)) or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(RelayIp)), RelayIp, "")
  | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
      or has_any_ipv4_prefix(RelayIp, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
  | extend
      EmailMailFromAddress = iff(EmailMailFromAddress contains "@", EmailMailFromAddress, ""),
      RelayHost = trim_end(@"\.", coalesce(RelayHost, Relay)),
      EmailProtocolName = case(tostring(sm.proto) =~ "SMTP" or tostring(sm.mailer) in~ ("smtp", "esmtp"), "SMTP", ""),
      EventSubType = iff(IsDelivery, "EmailSent", "EmailReceived")
  | extend
      SrcIpAddr = iff(IsDelivery, "", RelayIp),
      DstIpAddr = iff(IsDelivery, RelayIp, ""),
      Src = iff(IsDelivery, Dvc, coalesce(RelayIp, RelayHost)),
      Dst = iff(IsDelivery, coalesce(RelayIp, RelayHost), Dvc),
      SrcFQDN = iff(not(IsDelivery) and RelayHost contains ".", RelayHost, ""),
      SrcHostname = iff(IsDelivery, tostring(split(Dvc, ".")[0]), tostring(split(RelayHost, ".")[0])),
      SrcDomain = iff(IsDelivery, substring(Dvc, indexof(Dvc, ".") + 1), substring(RelayHost, indexof(RelayHost, ".") + 1)),
      DvcHostname = tostring(split(Dvc, ".")[0]),
      DvcDomain = iff(Dvc contains ".", substring(Dvc, indexof(Dvc, ".") + 1), ""),
      DvcFQDN = iff(Dvc contains ".", Dvc, ""),
      EmailMailFromDomain = iff(EmailMailFromAddress contains "@", tostring(split(EmailMailFromAddress, "@")[1]), ""),
      DvcAction = iff(IsDelivery and EventResult == "Success" and DeliveryStatus startswith "Sent", "Delivered", "NA")
  | extend
      SrcFQDN = iff(IsDelivery, DvcFQDN, SrcFQDN),
      SrcDomain = iff(iff(IsDelivery, Dvc, RelayHost) contains ".", SrcDomain, ""),
      DvcDomainType = iff(isnotempty(DvcDomain), "FQDN", ""),
      EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventVendor = "Proofpoint",
      EventProduct = "POD MailLog",
      EventSchema = "EmailEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventType = "EmailDelivery",
      EventOriginalType = "maillog",
      EmailDirection = "Unknown",
      EventOriginalResultDetails = strcat(Dsn, iff(isnotempty(Dsn) and isnotempty(DeliveryStatus), "; ", ""), DeliveryStatus),
      EventOriginalUid = tostring(column_ifexists("id", "")),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack("sm", sm, "tls", tls, "pps", pps, "metadata", metadata), dynamic({})),
      Type = "ProofpointPODMailLog_CL"
  | extend
      EventUid = iff(isnotempty(EventOriginalUid), strcat("ProofpointPODMailLog_CL:", EventOriginalUid), ""),
      SrcDomainType = iff(isnotempty(SrcDomain), "FQDN", ""), IpAddr = SrcIpAddr
  | project-rename EventMessage = data
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount,
      EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion,
      EventType, EventSubType, EventOriginalType, EventResult,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventOriginalUid, EventUid, EventMessage,
      Dvc, DvcHostname, DvcDomain, DvcDomainType, DvcFQDN, DvcAction, DvcEntityKey,
      Src, SrcIpAddr, SrcHostname, SrcDomain, SrcDomainType, SrcFQDN, Dst, DstIpAddr, IpAddr,
      EmailMailFromAddress, EmailMailFromDomain, EmailSizeBytes, EmailProtocolName, EmailDirection,
      AdditionalFields, AdditionalEntities
};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix,
  emailfromaddress_has_any=emailfromaddress_has_any, emailrecipient_has_any=emailrecipient_has_any,
  emailsubject_has_any=emailsubject_has_any, emaildirection_in=emaildirection_in,
  emaildeliverylocation_in=emaildeliverylocation_in, eventresult=eventresult, disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
